name: Epic Gold Corp.
summary: Epic Gold Corp. is a mineral exploration company, which engages in evaluating, acquiring, and exploring mineral properties in Canada. Its focus and primary objective is the exploration of the Bullseye. Its projects include Johnathan's Pond, Mount Peyton, Middle Ridge, True Grit, Great Bend, Gazeeow and Dog Bay. The company was founded on May 28, 2018 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
